# **12-Week Couch-to-5K Programme (with Strength, Intervals, Tempo, Test, and Race Prep)**

---

## **General Guidelines**

- **Warm-up:** 10–15 min before every run (brisk walk, dynamic stretches, light jog)
- **Cool-down:** 5–10 min easy walk and stretching
- **Asthma:** Inhaler on hand, avoid cold/dry air, stop if symptoms arise
- **Rest:** At least one rest day between runs; strength on non-run days
- **Hydration, nutrition, and sleep:** Encourage good habits throughout

---

## **Weekly Structure**

| Day        | Activity                |
|------------|------------------------|
| Monday     | Run                     |
| Tuesday    | Strength                |
| Wednesday  | Rest or gentle walk     |
| Thursday   | Run                     |
| Friday     | Strength                |
| Saturday   | Run (or parkrun/test/race) |
| Sunday     | Rest                    |

---

## **Weeks 1–4: Foundation**

### **Running Sessions**

**Week 1**
- 5 min brisk walk (WU)
- Alternate 60s jog / 90s walk x6
- 5 min walk (CD)

**Week 2**
- 5 min brisk walk
- Alternate 90s jog / 2 min walk x6
- 5 min walk

**Week 3**
- 5 min brisk walk
- 90s jog / 90s walk, 3 min jog / 3 min walk (repeat sequence twice)
- 5 min walk

**Week 4**
- 5 min brisk walk
- Alternate 3 min jog / 2 min walk x4
- 5 min walk

### **Strength Sessions (2x/week)**
- Squat to Chair: 2 x 12
- Incline Push-Up: 2 x 10
- Glute Bridge: 2 x 12
- Standing Band Row: 2 x 12
- Standing Calf Raise: 2 x 15
- Dead Bug: 2 x 10/side
- Side Plank: 2 x 20 sec/side

---

## **Weeks 5–8: Progression & Test**

### **Running Sessions**

**Week 5**
- **Session 1:** 5 min walk, 5 min jog / 3 min walk x2, 5 min walk
- **Session 2:** 5 min walk, 8 min jog / 5 min walk / 8 min jog, 5 min walk
- **Session 3:** 5 min walk, 10 min jog / 3 min walk / 10 min jog, 5 min walk

**Week 6**
- **Session 1:** 5 min walk, 12 min jog / 3 min walk / 8 min jog, 5 min walk
- **Session 2:** 5 min walk, 15 min jog / 3 min walk / 5 min jog, 5 min walk
- **Session 3:** 5 min walk, 20 min jog, 5 min walk

**Week 7**
- All sessions: 5 min walk, 22 min jog, 5 min walk

**Week 8**
- **Monday:** 5 min walk, 25 min jog, 5 min walk
- **Thursday:** 5 min walk, 25 min jog, 5 min walk
- **Saturday:** **Parkrun/Test 5K**  
  - 10–15 min warm-up (brisk walk, dynamic stretches, 5 min easy jog)  
  - 5K run/jog/walk as needed  
  - 5–10 min cool-down walk & stretch

### **Strength Sessions (2x/week)**
- Goblet Squat: 3 x 10
- Push-Up (full or incline): 3 x 8–10
- Single-Leg Glute Bridge: 2 x 10/leg
- Bent-Over Row: 3 x 10
- Reverse Lunge: 2 x 10/leg
- Standing Calf Raise: 3 x 15
- Bird Dog: 2 x 10/side
- Side Plank: 2 x 30 sec/side

---

## **Weeks 9–11: Pace, Intervals, Tempo**

### **Running Sessions**

**Each week:**
- **Session 1 (Easy):** 5 min walk, 28–32 min easy jog, 5 min walk (progress duration each week)
- **Session 2 (Intervals):**
  - Week 9: 5 min walk, 5 min jog, 4 x 2 min fast/2 min walk, 5 min jog, 5 min walk
  - Week 10: 5 min walk, 5 min jog, 5 x 90s fast/2 min walk, 5 min jog, 5 min walk
  - Week 11: 5 min walk, 5 min jog, 5 x 2 min fast/2 min walk, 5 min jog, 5 min walk
- **Session 3 (Tempo):**
  - Week 9: 5 min walk, 5 min jog, 8 min tempo, 5 min jog, 5 min walk
  - Week 10: 5 min walk, 5 min jog, 10 min tempo, 5 min jog, 5 min walk
  - Week 11: 5 min walk, 5 min jog, 12 min tempo, 5 min jog, 5 min walk

### **Strength Sessions (2x/week)**
- Split Squat: 3 x 8/leg
- Push-Up: 3 x 10–12
- Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift: 3 x 8/leg
- Seated Row: 3 x 12
- Step-Up: 2 x 10/leg
- Standing Calf Raise: 3 x 20
- Plank with Shoulder Tap: 2 x 12/side
- Side Plank: 2 x 40 sec/side

---

## **Week 12: Finisher / Race-Prep**

### **Running Sessions**

- **Monday (Easy):** 5 min walk, 20 min easy jog, 5 min walk
- **Tuesday (Strength):** Light full-body circuit (bodyweight only, 1–2 sets, focus on mobility)
- **Wednesday:** Rest or gentle walk, stretching, foam rolling, deep breathing
- **Thursday (Sharpening Intervals):** 5 min walk, 5 min jog, 3 x 1 min fast/2 min walk, 5 min jog, 5 min walk
- **Friday:** Rest, hydration, early night
- **Saturday (Race Day!):**
  - 10–15 min warm-up (brisk walk, dynamic stretches, 5 min easy jog, a few short pick-ups)
  - **5K run** (steady, sustainable pace, walk if needed, inhaler on hand)
  - 5–10 min cool-down walk, stretching
- **Sunday:** Recovery walk, stretching, celebrate!

---

## **Asthma & Recovery Reminders**

- **Warm up thoroughly** before every run, especially intervals and tempo.
- **Monitor symptoms**; use inhaler as prescribed.
- **Avoid cold/dry air**; use a buff/scarf if needed.
- **Hydrate, eat balanced meals, and prioritize sleep**—especially in race week.
- **Celebrate milestones** (Week 8 parkrun, Week 12 5K)!
